data: O-HAZE test images 41-45; five equally weighted RGB images.
resize: Resize each original image with bicubic interpolation and antialiasing. Preserve aspect ratio. Round each target dimension.
prediction: Remove model padding, then clamp the FP32 output to [0, 1] for metrics.
target: Use the corresponding resized FP32 target without clamp.
formal_psnr: Unchanged: 10 * torch.log10(1 / F.mse_loss(prediction, target)), after the original prediction clamp and FP32 cast.
replay_psnr: The evidence stores CPU float64 MSE/PSNR. It does not replace historical long-side-512 table PSNR values.
scale_rule: At each input scale, resize input and target from the originals to the same size. Compare the output at that size. Do not map the output to long side 512.
legacy_pooled_ssim: Historical or replayed SSIM with the former image pre-pooling step. Keep it separate from direct SSIM.
